{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
'''Sinuous carvings''' associated with [[Abeloth]] were identified in [[44 ABY]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. Reliefs featuring the carvings depicted serpents, vines, tentacles, ropes, and entrails in Abeloth's [[Ancient ruins (Abeloth's planet)|ruins]] on her [[Abeloth's planet|planet]]. The same reliefs existed on at least half a dozen planets that suffered cataclysms and rendered uninhabitable long before recorded history. Such worlds included<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]]<ref name="Caulus Tertius">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &ndash; Based on corresponding data for [[Caulus Tertius system/Legends|Caulus Tertius system]]</ref> [[Caulus Tertius]] and the [[Kathol Outback/Legends|Kathol Outback's]] [[Shatuun]].<ref name="Warfare Celestials" />

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], academic [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Insmot Bowen]] and his researchers believed that the appearance of such reliefs in ancient civilizations' art corresponded with their contact with the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]] and subsequent destruction. Dr. Bowen also noted the sinuous carvings' resemblance with the ancient [[ophidian grotesques]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Warfare Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> The relief's symbols corresponded with those of the "[[Destructors]]" in the legends of the<ref name="Vortex" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Kesh">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &ndash; Based on corresponding data for [[Kesh system/Legends|Kesh system]]</ref> world [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="Vortex" /> The [[Celestial Palace]] of the ancient [[Thuruht]] hive on a [[Unidentified astronomical object (Reo system)|world]] in the [[Maraqoo sector/Legends|Maraqoo sector's]] [[Reo system/Legends|Reo system]]<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref> in Wild Space<ref name="EAOC Reo">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Reo system/Legends|Reo system]]</ref> also featured sinuous carvings, including symbols of beasts and fiends that were unfamiliar to both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who studied ophidian grotesques and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="Apocalypse" />

{{Stub}}
